payload.feedback:
Revise. Much of this plan is accurate, but the statements below are false at 41e008194f1cbb92b9c986df74feb7810f33aa23. Correct each one from the checkout, not from memory, and keep everything that is accurate.
1. README.md has no heading for the Phase 4 authorization and none for Journal persistence (PR 2b): both are bold paragraphs under ## Status. README.md never mentions PlanStore, PlannerLoop or 0010_plan_store, and ## Verifying lists no migrations. Anchor every edit to text that is there, quoted exactly.
2. PrimaryLane.exchangePlanner is in packages/gateway-daemon/src/lanes.ts, not daemon.ts.
3. judgeRoundPlan and isWithinScope are in packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts, not plan-doc.ts, which holds judgePlanDoc.
4. The journal chain is chainHash(prior, row bytes) from GENESIS_CHAIN_HASH (packages/journal/src/chain.ts). prevRowHash, rowHash and GENESIS_PREV_HASH do not exist.
5. attest(commandId), dispatch(work), awaitPlan(commandId) and reconcile(commandId) are the PlannerPort interface in packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts. AdapterV1 (packages/madbridge-consumed/src/adapter/adapter-v1.ts) has attest() with no argument, prepareConfigPreview, launch, notifyInbox, pause and terminate. Do not call madbridge-consumed the planner dispatch contract.
6. The counted-run runner has no command-line flags. npm run phase4:counted-run takes no arguments and reads PHASE4_TERMS_FILE, PHASE4_TERMS_SHA256, PHASE4_EVIDENCE_DIR, CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN and the rest from the environment (packages/run-harness/src/phase4/cli.ts).
7. Nothing outside planner-recovery.ts constructs PlannerRecovery or calls recoverRoom. POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round calls PlannerLoop.runRound directly (packages/control-plane/src/counted-run.ts). Do not say recovery runs before a round.
8. AgyPlannerExecutor.attest answers from the lane alone: no process starts and nothing is hashed. The planner-user process check and the agy hash happen when the work starts. The executor returns the parsed plan document, not raw text.
9. The executor does not detect or reject tool calls: run_command, write_file and edit_file appear nowhere in it. Do not describe a tool-call guard.
10. judgeRoundPlan does not check credentials. The plan store refuses a plan that holds credential-shaped strings and the round fails as plan_refused. Nothing is redacted.
11. T5 moves PLAN_REVIEW to BUILDING and T22 moves the room to CLOSED_ABANDONED (packages/contracts/src/transitions.ts). There are no APPROVED or CANCELLED states.
12. Lifecycle events are in build_room_events; there is no room_events table. The room lock L3 is a row lock on build_room_rooms; there is no room_state.
13. Migration 0010_plan_store makes build_room_plans append-only with a foreign key to build_room_events and has no xmin check: the xmin = pg_current_xact_id()::xid check is in packages/control-plane/src/plan-store.ts. The runtime grant on command_journal_append is in 0006, not 0007 to 0009.
14. GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round returns roomId, actId, deploymentId, gateway, dispatcherSurfaceRegistered and round. It has no latestT2, latestT3, latestT4, terminalEvent, commands or unresolvedCount.
15. The Gateway evidence has no stdoutTail, stderrTail or postKillSurvivors fields.
16. The revision reaches the Planner as revision with feedback and revisingPlanHash (PlannerWork in planner-loop.ts), not revisionFeedback.
Before returning the plan, check every file, function, field, table, state and command it names against the checkout.

Revise once more. Your 16 corrections are right, and the anchors you quote from README.md are right. But this round adds new names that do not exist at 41e008194f1cbb92b9c986df74feb7810f33aa23, and some that round 1 had right are now wrong. This is the last round: the next plan is approved or the run is cancelled.
The rule for this round: name a file, function, class, route, header, field, table, migration, code or test only if you opened the file and saw it there. Where you have not, describe the behaviour in plain words without a name, or leave it out. A shorter section that is all true is the goal; keep the whole plan under 25,000 characters.
Correct these:
1. The Gateway planner routes are POST /gateway/planner/poll and POST /gateway/planner/report (packages/control-plane/src/gateway/routes.ts), as round 1 had them. /pull and /reply do not exist. The signed purposes are planner_poll and planner_report; the requests are attest, execute and status. planner.attest, planner.dispatch, planner.await, planner.reconcile, planner.reply, planner.pull and planner.work do not exist.
2. packages/madbridge-consumed holds adapter, artifact-store, broker, ledger, policy and protocol (read PROVENANCE.json and list src). SessionFsm, EventEnvelopeV1 and ApprovalV1 do not exist there; do not list four frozen capabilities.
3. The worker class is GatewayPlannerWorker (packages/gateway-daemon/src/planner-worker.ts). The executor is chosen by choosePlannerExecutor when BUILDROOM_PLANNER_EXECUTOR is agy (planner-executor-factory.ts). PlannerWorker, createPlannerExecutorFromEnv and BUILDROOM_AGY_PLANNER_CONFIG do not exist.
4. PlannerWork has commandId, roomId, repository, baseSha, scopePaths, goalEventId, goal, goalDigest, the optional revision, provider, model and executionSurface. It has no round, controllingInputs, seatContractRef or executionSurfaceRef.
5. Command journal rows are journaled, identity_bound, dispatched, completed, failed, unresolved and resolved (packages/journal/src/event-row.ts); decisions are decision record rows. command.dispatched, command.completed, command.failed, command.cancelled and decision.recorded do not exist.
6. The failure classifications are PLANNER_FAILURES in planner-loop.ts: authorization_does_not_cover, authorization_indeterminate, attestation_failed, identity_mismatch, not_sent, route_mismatch, planner_reported_failure, plan_invalid, plan_outside_captured_scope, plan_refused and the rest of that list. dispatch_refused, transport_lost, execution_failed, plan_rejected, plan_not_ready, plan_out_of_scope, submission_failed, gateway_reconciled and blocked_unresolved_command do not exist.
7. The round order is as round 1 had it: T2 and the journaled row are written first, then the route is authorized and attest runs, then identity_bound is journaled, then dispatch. An attestation failure is journaled as failed after T2.
8. PlannerRecovery has no outcomes named gone_never_sent, gone_after_send or still_running. If you describe recovery, describe only what planner-recovery.ts shows.
9. The executor has no refusal codes named planner_user_busy, already_dispatched or model_mismatch, no function assertNoPlannerUserProcesses, and no detached process group.
10. The Founder plan routes are GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan behind CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN and POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision behind PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN. The decision body has only decision (plan.approved, plan.revision_requested or founder.cancel), planHash, feedback, eventId and attribution. There is no /rooms/:roomId/plan or /rooms/:roomId/plan-decision, and no decision_id, command_id, rationale, decided_by, approve, revise or cancel.
11. The counted-run routes are POST and GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round and GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/journal only, always mounted, answering 503 when PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN or PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN is unset, and authorized by the counted-run token alone. There is no /goal route (the goal arrives with T1 on POST /rooms/:roomId/events), no PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_CONFIG and no X-Counted-Run-Token header.
12. These names do not exist: openRoundDispatch, requireSameTransaction, recordFounderGoal, PlanDecisionService, createPlanDecisionRouter, createPlanReadRouter, createCountedRunRouter, recordDecision.
13. Migration 0007 is 0007_gate_runs. 0007_command_journal_append_room_lock_l3 does not exist.
14. The runner writes attempts.json, run.lock, plan-<planHash>.json, <label>-<roomId>.record.json and <label>-<roomId>.record.sha256 directly in PHASE4_EVIDENCE_DIR, as round 1 had it. There is no per-run directory and no entry-verification.json, goal-registration.json, round-N-poll.json, decision-N.json, journal.json, run-unit-result.json or phase4-summary.json.
15. Phase4-CR1, Phase4-CR2 and Phase4-CR3 are three runs of the same kind, made in order, each passing only on the Founder approving its plan. CR2 is not a revision run and CR3 is not a failure or cancellation run.
16. test/planner-loop.test.ts, test/planner-recovery.test.ts and test/phase4-counted-run.test.ts do not exist; the files are test/planner-loop.storage.test.ts, test/planner-recovery.storage.test.ts and test/phase4-counted-run-cli.test.ts. List the test directory before naming a test.
Before returning the plan, check every name in it against the checkout, and remove any you did not see.
